mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_ledger WHERE business_no=#{businessNo} AND entry_type='REFUND_SUCCEEDED'
SELECT * FROM refund_order WHERE refund_no=#{refundNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM refund_account WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_source(source_no,payment_no,order_no,source_type,authorized_cents,authorization_version,authorization_hash) VALUES(#{authorization.sourceNo},#{authorization.paymentNo},#{authorization.orderNo},#{authorization.sourceType},#{authorization.amountCents},#{authorization.version},#{authorizationHash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_no=source_no
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_source WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_account SET reserved_refund_cents=reserved_refund_cents+#{amountCents},version=version+1 WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} AND #{amountCents}>0 AND #{amountCents}<=paid_amount_cents-succeeded_refund_cents-reserved_refund_cents

UPDATE refund_source SET reserved_cents=reserved_cents+#{amountCents},active_refund_no=#{refundNo},version=version+1 WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} AND active_refund_no IS NULL AND #{amountCents}>0 AND #{amountCents}<=authorized_cents-reserved_cents-succeeded_cents

UPDATE refund_order SET status=IF(channel_version=0,'UNKNOWN',status),last_error='通道结果未知，先查询原退款号',version=version+1 WHERE refund_no=#{refundNo} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND review_required='NO'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM process_task WHERE task_type='REFUND' AND ((state='READY' AND next_retry_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE aggregate_type='REFUND' AND ((status='READY' AND next_retry_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
